name: Clotiapine
summary: Clotiapine (Entumine) is an atypical antipsychotic of the dibenzothiazepine chemical class. It was first introduced in a few European countries (namely, Belgium, Italy, Spain and Switzerland), Argentina, Taiwan and Israel in 1970.

uses.text: Despite the relativity high rate of undesired effects it has demonstrated efficacy in treatment-resistant individuals with schizophrenia according to a number of psychiatrists with clinical experience with it, some weak clinical evidence supports this view too.

pharmacology.en: It blocks dopamine D2 and serotonin 5-HT2A receptors, the usual targets of atypical antipsychotics. It also blocks histamine and other receptors, which adds to its sedating effect.
pharmacology.zh: 它會阻斷多巴胺 D2 與血清素 5-HT2A 受體，這是非典型抗精神病藥常見的作用目標。它也會阻斷組織胺等其他受體，增加鎮靜作用。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它会阻断多巴胺 D2 与血清素 5-HT2A 受体，这是非典型抗精神病药常见的作用目标。它也会阻断组织胺等其他受体，增加镇静作用。

sideEffects.en: Common effects include drowsiness, dizziness on standing, dry mouth, constipation, weight gain and movement problems such as stiffness. Rarely it causes neuroleptic malignant syndrome, which is life-threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 常見作用包括嗜睡、起身時頭暈、口乾、便秘、體重增加，以及僵硬等動作問題。少數情況下會引發危及生命的抗精神病藥惡性症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见作用包括嗜睡、起身时头晕、口干、便秘、体重增加，以及僵硬等动作问题。少数情况下会引发危及生命的抗精神病药恶性症候群。

fact.en: Clotiapine shares its dibenzothiazepine ring system with quetiapine, a much more widely used antipsychotic. It went on sale in Taiwan in 1970.
fact.zh: 氯噻平與使用更廣泛的抗精神病藥喹硫平共享二苯并硫氮平環系統。它在 1970 年於台灣上市。
fact.zhHans: 氯噻平与使用更广泛的抗精神病药喹硫平共享二苯并硫氮平环系统。它在 1970 年于台湾上市。
